items.title: Enhancer-targeted CRISPR-A rescues haploinsufficiency and mutant phenotypes in organoid models of autism
items.author: Daniel H. Geschwind
items.content: CRISPR activation targeted to enhancers of autism risk genes CHD8 and SCN2A selectively increased expression and reversed mutant phenotypes in both patient-derived and gene-edited neuron and cortical organoid models of autism.

items.title: Gene discovery and pleiotropic architecture of multidimensional pain in a genome-wide association study of >1.2 million individuals
items.author: Henry R. Kranzler
items.content: We conducted a meta-analytic genome-wide association study of multidimensional pain in >1.2 million European-ancestry individuals. We identified 343 independent loci, which, alongside findings from a sex-stratified GWAS and other analyses, expand our knowledge of the genetics of pain.

items.title: Information formatting in neuronal populations predicts differential functional contributions to behavior
items.author: Marlene R. Cohen
items.content: Using experiments in monkeys and modeling, the authors demonstrate that the formatting of population information predicts the contribution of different brain areas to behavior.

items.title: Single-neuron encoding of rapidly learned visual information reshapes human perception
items.author: Gabriel Kreiman
items.content: The authors show that rapid learning modulates neuronal activity in the human visual cortex, requiring extra processing time to support recognition and relaying signals to memory-related regions without requiring feedback.

items.title: The human claustrum tracks uncertainty and prediction error
items.content: Single-neuron recordings provide direct evidence that the human claustrum tracks uncertainty and prediction errors during adaptive behavior. Its responses differed from those in the anterior cingulate cortex, which raises the possibility that these regions make distinct contributions to updating beliefs and guiding behavior in ever-changing environments.
